title: Sandy Smiles
meta_description: Sandy Smiles: 4BR coastal home in Seagrove near beaches, community pool, bikes, outdoor shower, private patio, and walking distance to beach accesses.
description_expanded:
ABOUT THE HOME:

Sandy Smiles is a beautifully designed coastal contemporary home that's within walking distance to 30A beaches and restaurants. This four-bedroom open concept designed home has a bedroom on the first floor, and three more upstairs, making it ideal for a multi-generational getaway on 30A. The expansive kitchen is equipped with everything you will need in your home away from home. And there's plenty of room to enjoy a meal around the large high top dining table that seats eight and additional seating for four at the kitchen island.

Enjoy your evening beverage while rocking on the front porch or dine alfresco on the peaceful back patio.

ABOUT THE AREA:
Seagrove is one of the charming coastal communities that sits on 30A nestled between Seaside Beach and Watersound, it offers an array of public beach accesses and great restaurants. You'll find restaurants and shops within walking distance, and a quick bike ride will land you in Seaside, a well-known 30A spot with farmers markets, shops, restaurants, and local food trucks to fill your entire party's needs. Take a quick bike ride east in the opposite direction, and you can find yourself at the Big Chill, a popular outdoor space filled with restaurants, outdoor games, and big screen TVs to watch any sporting event your heart desires. 30A is located in between the beach and a 15,000-acre forest that is filled with hiking trails and off-road trails, for those that want to skip the beach or want a different experience. From long walks on the beach, to taking Jeeps off road, 30a has everything you and your guests will need to enjoy a great beach get away.

\*\*\* Walking Distance to the Beach
\*\*\* Community Pool
\*\*\* 2 Complimentary Adult Bikes

BEACH ACCESS:

Your home is in walking distance to two beach accesses. Walk towards 30A and then One Seagrove is to your left and Beachwood Villa access is to your right.

One Seagrove Access - has a shower but no car parking.

Beachwood Villas Access - has a bike rack and access to a shower, but no car parking.

ACCOMMODATIONS: 4 Bedrooms, 3 Baths
• Bedroom 1 -- Full Bed -- 1st Floor
• Bedroom 2 -- King Bed, Jack n' Jill Bath -- 2nd Floor
• Bedroom 3 -- King Bed, Jack n' Jill Bath -- 2nd Floor
• Bedroom 4 -- King Bed, Ensuite Bath -- 2nd Floor

PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS:

• Community pool
• Walking distance to two beach accesses
• 2 Complimentary Bikes
• Private backyard deck/patio with outdoor dining
• Outdoor shower
• Beverage/wine refrigerator in kitchen
• Washer \& Dryer
• TV's in every bedroom and living room
• WIFI and Internet
• Full linen package -- bedding, towels
• Fully equipped kitchen
• Self-Check-In

AvantStay provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, ski gear, beach gear, and more. For anything you need, we're at your fingertips via concierge@avantstay.com.

30A is a 20-mile stretch of beaches and coastal towns along Florida's famous Emerald Coast. From Seaside down past Laguna, you'll find white sands, azure waters, and laid-back vibes. This region takes a relaxed approach to oceanfront living, with boutique shops and local seafood on every main street. Each town along 30A has its own unique identity, so we encourage you to explore them all!

Local Attractions: The Big Chill 30A, Gulf Place Plaza, Camp Helen State Park, Henderson Beach State Park A, Village of Baytowne Wharf, Grayton Beach State Park, Alys Beach, Seaside Beach, Watercolor Beach

Home Truths:
- Unfortunately, pets are not allowed in this home. If undisclosed pets are brought into the home without AvantStay's approval, there is a fine of $500 per pet.

Parking Details:
- There are 2 parking spots in the driveway.

All bookings over 30 days require a security deposit to be charged after booking.

Bath: Travel-Sized Toiletries (Shower Gel, Shampoo, Conditioner, Soap)
